references.text: Jesus also escapes here an attempt to be taken or killed by slipping out of the hands of the people, paralleling how he earlier in the chapter escaped being stoned.
An earlier attempt to seize Jesus failed because his hour had not yet come, which repeats the motif of divine protection against violence.
After this event, the religious leaders plan to kill Jesus and send guards to arrest him, but he is not present, showing that his time has not yet come.
A parallel prayer for deliverance from the enemy's hand, where God protects the righteous from being captured or killed by opponents.
